text: This staff report is about a matter for which Community Council has delegated authority to make a final decision, provided that it is not amended so that it varies with City policy or by-laws. Transportation Services is requesting North York Community Council to authorize the installation of a pedestrian crossover on Rosewell Avenue, south of Lawrence Avenue West. This installation will be part of a pilot program to review locations for a new type of pedestrian crossover that was recently approved for use in the Province of Ontario. The subject location of Rosewell Avenue is a suitable candidate for this pilot program. The pedestrian crossing volumes meet the installation criteria for this new type of pedestrian crossover. This location provides direct access to an elementary school and will assist pedestrian crossings and enhance safety for all road users.
North York Community Council: 1. Approved the installation of a pedestrian crossover on Rosewell Avenue, approximately 226 metres south of Lawrence Avenue West.
